reason: I might try the free 40 to see if it can read my staff's handwritten nota, but I would not pay. Duplicates and padded receipts are a people problem I handle by checking with my staff, and I already put the numbers in a sheet myself.
objection: Another monthly subscription for something I can do with my own eyes and a free Google Sheet, and I doubt it reads messy handwritten Indonesian nota from the building shop correctly.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial showed it actually caught money leaking that I had missed, more than the $19 it costs each month.
